theme: Dark Cyber-Club Neon Aesthetic (Seoul / Tokyo Nightlife meets Prague Underground)

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
headings.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight

spacing_and_layout.bento_mode: Tetris Grid with high visual tension and asymmetrical spans

visual_enhancers.texture_overlays: Subtle noise grain overlay (2% opacity) + faint horizontal scanlines for club poster feel
visual_enhancers.tape_marquees: Continuous infinite text marquee ribbon with high-energy event tags (DUPLEX x SEOULVIBES x GANGSHII)

public_landing.navbar: Sticky glassmorphic top header with event date countdown ticker, nav links (Lineup, Floors, Tickets, VIP, FAQ), and 'BUY TICKETS' glowing CTA
public_landing.hero: Kinetic typography reveal 'ASIA TAKEOVER FESTIVAL - PRAGUE 2026', massive date '27.09.2026', venue badge 'DUPLEX PRAGUE', presented by DUPLEX x SeoulVibes x GANGSHII, animated audio equalizer bars & live ticket counter
public_landing.lineup_section: 10 Featured DJs filterable by Genre (K-POP, HipHop/RnB, Vinahouse, J-POP, Pop Hits, Choreography Dance), interactive DJ cards with music genre tags, stage time slots, and sound preview trigger
public_landing.floors_experience: 3 Floors + 2 Rooftops interactive floorplan selector (Main Stage, Underground Vinahouse Vault, K-POP Sky Terrace, Rooftop Lounge 1, Rooftop Lounge 2), photo highlights & photobooth zone info
public_landing.tickets_section: Interactive ticket pricing tiers (Early Bird, General Admission, VIP Sky Lounge, Ultra VIP Table). MOCKED payment flow with instant QR E-ticket generator modal & PDF download simulation
public_landing.faq_section: Collapsible interactive accordion answering dress code, door policy (18+), Soju bar list, photobooth zones, location details
public_landing.contact_and_location: Interactive map preview of Duplex Prague (Wenceslas Square), VIP booking form, contact details, social links

features: Real-time sales revenue & ticket breakdown statistics (charts via Recharts)
Orders & E-tickets list table with search, filter, export, and status toggles
Event Party CRUD Manager (Add/Edit/Remove DJ line-ups, floor schedules, set times)
CMS Content Editor for site announcements, ticket prices, and hero banners
Live camera video viewport / QR scanner target overlay with pulsating laser guide
Manual ticket ID / QR hash lookup fallback input
Instant audio-visual response modal (Green Pass 'VALID TICKET - VIP ACCESS' vs Red Alert 'INVALID OR ALREADY USED')
Real-time door check-in feed log with timestamp and door guard stats counter

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, menu items, table rows) contain role-based data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='buy-ticket-button', data-testid='qr-scanner-input').
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, popovers, or floating headers. Use backdrop-blur with minimum 60% opacity dark background.
Do not use generic 'Inter' font for main display headings. Use bold display typography with tight letter-spacing (tracking-tighter) and uppercase styling.
Ensure all mock checkout payments succeed smoothly and output a visual QR Code ticket with downloadable/printable format.
Ensure /nascanujtobrasko door scanner allows testing both via simulated camera feed scan and instant manual code entry.
